title: SBS 3.1, a novel natural product small molecule regulates TNF-alpha-induced NF-kappaB activation and key signals of inflammation to promote apoptosis in lung cancer tumour microenvironment.
one_liner_zh: 该文通过虚拟筛选和分子动力学模拟研究天然产物SBS-3.1靶向NF-κB p50亚基DNA结合域并抑制其激活，属于蛋白质-DNA互作相关但非典型TF-DNA体系，方法上结合了对接与MD模拟，可为本课题提供界面建模参考。
abstract: Chronic inflammation leads to many maladies in lung cancer. Tumor necrosis factor-alpha (T NF- alpha), a pleiotropic proinflammatory cytokine regulates the activation of the nuclear factor-kappaB (NF-kappaB) to drive many physiological and pathological signaling pathways in inflammation and cancer apoptosis. This study identified a novel natural product to inhibit T NF-alpha induced NF-kappaB activation. Virtual docking of ZINC natural product library and computational modeling analysis showed compounds that target crucial amino acid residues on p50 protein involved in DNA binding. Molecular dynamic simulation showed, compound SBS-3.1, as the best lead compound that binds efficiently and stably with p50 protein. MMP BSA analysis of the lead compound predicted a favorable binding free energy. The compound inhibited the proliferations of T NF-alpha induced A-549 with a GI50 value of 30.53 muM. SBS-3.1 decreased the percentage of T NF-alpha induced NF-kappaB-65, p38 and ERK1/2 positive lung cancer cells, while the apoptosis in these cells were elevated. In summary, SBS-3.1, a natural product, was identified as the lead compound targeting Rel-homology region of p50. Inhibition of NF-kappaB and inflammatory signals by SBS 3.1 promoted apoptosis in lung cancer. Further research can bring new therapeutic strategies for treating inflammation associated T ME of lung cancer cells.Communicated by Ramaswamy H. Sarma.
abstract_zh: 慢性炎症导致肺癌中的多种疾病。肿瘤坏死因子-α（TNF-α），一种多效性促炎细胞因子，调节核因子-κB（NF-κB）的激活，以驱动炎症和癌症凋亡中的许多生理和病理信号通路。本研究鉴定了一种新型天然产物，用于抑制TNF-α诱导的NF-κB激活。ZINC天然产物库的虚拟对接和计算建模分析显示，化合物靶向p50蛋白上参与DNA结合的关键氨基酸残基。分子动力学模拟表明，化合物SBS-3.1作为最佳先导化合物，能与p50蛋白高效且稳定地结合。先导化合物的MMPBSA分析预测了有利的结合自由能。该化合物抑制TNF-α诱导的A-549细胞增殖，其GI50值为30.53 μM。SBS-3.1降低了TNF-α诱导的NF-κB-65、p38和ERK1/2阳性肺癌细胞的百分比，同时这些细胞中的凋亡率升高。总之，SBS-3.1作为一种天然产物，被鉴定为靶向p50的Rel同源区域的先导化合物。SBS-3.1对NF-κB和炎症信号的抑制促进了肺癌细胞的凋亡。进一步的研究可为治疗肺癌细胞炎症相关肿瘤微环境带来新的治疗策略。由Ramaswamy H. Sarma通讯。
